issue: Missing validation feedback for empty title
actual: Clearing the resume title to empty or whitespace-only and pressing Enter correctly reverts to the previous title "Untitled Resume" (title is not renamed to empty), but no error message, toast, or any visible validation feedback is shown to the user anywhere in the DOM or notifications region.

Reopened the resume from the dashboard; contact details, summary, work experience, education, and skills content, plus the renamed "Career History" heading and Classic template, were all correctly preserved.

actual: Dashboard only exposes a search textbox and a sort dropdown (Newest First/Oldest First/Title A-Z/Title Z-A). There is no date filter control (no date picker, no date-range input, no filter-by-date UI element) anywhere on the dashboard, so resumes cannot be filtered by exact creation date or date range.

issue: No data persistence across page reload
actual: Before reload, dashboard had 5 resumes including newly created "Software Engineer - TechCorp Application" and duplicated/renamed "Backend Engineer - StartupXYZ Application" (with edited Location fields). After navigating/reloading http://localhost:6005/, only the 3 originally-seeded resumes remain (Product Designer Resume, Marketing Manager Resume, Software Engineer Resume); the new and duplicated resumes and all edits made during the session were lost. Confirmed via browser_evaluate that localStorage is empty ({}), indicating the app has no persistence layer - all created/edited/duplicated/renamed resume data exists only in-memory and does not survive a reload.
